description: This PHP source file defines the SentSubController class within the Goteo application, specifically for administrative management of sent email campaigns. It includes actions for viewing email details, removing emails from blacklist, resending emails, and listing sent emails, with dependencies on various models like Mail, User, Template, and Node.

classes.name: SentSubController
classes.description: Controller class managing the administrative functions related to sent emails, including viewing details, resending, and listing sent emails within the Goteo application.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the user has permissions to access the sent email functionalities based on node role and user role.

methods.name: detailAction
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific sent email, including statistics and recipient list.

methods.name: removeblacklistAction
methods.description: Removes an email address from the blacklist.

methods.name: resendAction
methods.description: Resends an email to a recipient, handling both individual and mass mailing.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists sent emails with filtering and pagination.
